name: Cahn-Hilliard solver performance benchmark
description: Measures computational performance (accuracy, stability, runtime) of Cahn–Hilliard equation solver implementations using a semi-implicit Fourier spectral method across standard test problems.
evaluation_method: runtime and numerical error metrics (e.g., L2 error / convergence rate) combined with stability assessments
general_score_metric: composite of runtime and numerical error (e.g., L2 norm / CPU time)
reputation: A specialized, domain-focused benchmark used within computational physics/chemistry communities for evaluating solver implementations rather than broad ML adoption.
notes: Non-ML benchmark; results are highly hardware- and implementation-dependent. Sensitive to discretization, parameter choices, and reproducibility issues; small/standardized test problems may not reflect all real-world scenarios.
